rows.en:
(I'm getting pretty used to the EX-Gear...
Gotta keep it up like this.)
Looks like you've been working hard.

Claire-senpai,
you were watching? That's embarrassing...

What's wrong with that?
It's not like watching wears you out.
I'm bad at it, so it's embarrassing.

No need to be modest.
You were riding the wind pretty well.
It makes me happy to hear you say that, Senpai...

But never get careless or cocky.
Stay focused and nail every single flight.
Yes! Got it!

Hehe... What a good kid~
As a reward, I'll treat you to a juice.
(...I'll do my best next time too!)

(I'm getting pretty used to the EX-Gear...
I'll keep it up like this.)
(...I'll do my best next time too!)

(This week was tiring too...
I'm gonna take it easy this weekend~)

\p-kun,
you seem to be in a good mood.

Oh, Claire-senpai!
Are you heading home now?
Mm-hm, that's right.
Do you have any plans for the weekend, Senpai?

Plans for the weekend?
Hmm, let's see... Nothing in particular right now, but...

But if a certain someone asked me out on a date,
I'd have plans...
A-A certain someone?

*sigh*... I'm saying call me if you're free.
See you!
Ah, Senpai!

(...Maybe I should ask Senpai to hang out
this weekend?)

(This week was tiring too~
I'm gonna take it easy this weekend~!)

\p-chan,
you seem to be in a good mood.

But if someone asked me out on a date,
I'd have plans...
S-Someone?
(...Ugh, I can't focus when it's this hot.)

Mmph!
Cl-Claire-senpai, I'm sorry...!
Oh, \p-kun...
Do you like gym clothes that much...?

N-No, I was just spacing out...
I'm really sorry!!
Watch where you're going, okay?
(......That was soft...)
(...Ugh, I can't focus when it's this hot...)
Oh, \p-chan...
(......That was soft...)

(I wandered into town for no real reason...
Was there something I needed to buy...?)
Claire-senpai! What a coincidence.

It is.
Are you out shopping too?
No, I was just wandering around.

Then this is perfect.
There's something I'd like you to help me with...
Sure, I'll help.
Okay then, first stop, that department store~!

(Before I knew it, I'd been turned
into Senpai's bag carrier...)

(I wandered into town for no real reason...
Was there something I needed to buy...?)
\p-chan.
No, I was just out for a little stroll...

(Before I knew it, I'd been turned
into Senpai's bag carrier...)

(Next class is in another room...
What a pain, but oh well...)

Cl-Claire-senpai!
What's with that outfit...?
My next class is swimming.

I can see that, but...
why are you inside the school building?

I forgot something,
so I rushed back to get it.
I'm sensing a rather pervy stare here.
I-I'm not looking!
Just kidding! See you~
(...Okay, I'd better head to class too!)

(Next class is in another room...
What a pain...)
Oh, \p-chan.
O-Oh, I see...
I'm sensing a rather pervy stare here...?
I-I'm not looking, okay!?
(...Okay, I'd better head to class too!)

uncertain: c16084/c16090/c16101: generic greetings also used by Grace (scd_fes_807) and Sheryl (nml_she_020, nml_she_005); wording neutral enough for all speakers.
c16083 (shared m/f): "wafu" is the muffled noise of the player bumping face-first into Claire (she then asks if the player likes gym clothes that much); rendered "Mmph!".
c16057: "heru mono ja arumai shi" (it won't wear out) rendered "It's not like watching wears you out."
c16073/c16080: male version "dareka-san" (a certain someone, pointed) vs female "dareka" (someone); kept the difference.
